tool: AWS Lambda Power Tuning (open source, deployed as a Step Functions state machine)

pricingUsedForEstimates.note: Estimated compute cost = memory (GB) x average duration (s) x price. Excludes the $0.20 per 1M request charge, which is the same at every memory size.

notes: Durations were decoded from the Power Tuning visualization link produced by the run.
The tool's own cost figure for 1024 MB (8.568e-7) is slightly higher than the estimate above because Lambda bills each invocation's duration rounded up to the nearest millisecond.
Best cost and best time were both 1024 MB, the largest value tested. Re-run with 1536, 2048 and 3008 MB to find where the curve flattens.
